reviewSupplement.answer: Both B and C are true: liver has many metabolic roles and produces bile. A is false if “largest organ” includes skin; liver is the largest internal solid organ. Therefore D is not valid as printed.
reviewSupplement.note: Two true options and an incorrect “largest organ” statement; retain manual.

reviewSupplement.answer: C if “most to least” means usual abundance/count: cells→tissues→organs→systems. If it means complexity the intended order is reversed; wording is ambiguous.
reviewSupplement.note: “Most to least” fails to identify abundance or complexity. Teacher must clarify.
